title: Myrmidon
summary: Myrmidon is a Krono-Titan whose muscular body is donned with red clothes and gold armor in the style of an ancient Greek warrior. He is equipped with a clawed gauntlet on his left hand and wields a sword for combat. A Myrmidon Amulet is in the possession of Hoffman.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Myrmidon Titans were the origin of the the Myrmidons, warriors commanded by Achilles in Greek mythology. 

In Peru, Myrmidon was invoked by Hoffman to attack Dante Vale and Zhalia Moon. He was attacked by Gar-Ghoul but was able to defeat it with help from Wilder's Weakenshade spell. Myrmidon then finished off Elf King Oberon before being defeated by Lok's Baselaird. [Doorway to Huntik]

Myrmidon was used by Hoffman, alongside a Suit's Venomaster to fight against Dante's Powerbonded Caliban. After being hit by a misaimed poison attack by Venomaster, Myrmidon was defeated by Caliban. [Zhalia's Mission]

Hoffman later invoked Myrmidon in the underwater ruins of Yonaguni where he and a Suit's Shadow Agent fought against Powerbonded Pendragon. He was later joined by Wilder's Grand Façade but they were all knocked backwards when Lok summoned Kyojin, with a huge whirlpool sucking the Organization and their Titans underwater. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Myrmidon is a strong warrior and uses his immense strength to best other Titans of his size. In addition to hand-to-hand combat, he can use his sword to assist in battle.
